The three fixes in bc1fbd4a9f are correct (ticket_owner key and rule-2 refusal with no ticket, --limit 1000 with a full result reported not measured, the mktemp-failed row). Two advisory gaps of the same class remain: the issue search in tickets() has --limit 50 with no full-result handling, and red_rows ignores a missing green that the judge counts red.
